meta.title: Cargo board: post your cargo, carriers send offers · YukSaroy
meta.description: The cargo owner writes where from, where to, what and how much. Carriers and drivers offer a price, the owner picks one.

hero.title: Have cargo, need a truck?
hero.lead: Write where from, where to, what cargo and when. Nearby carriers and drivers send a price, you pick the best one. It is free.
hero.forCarriers: Are you a carrier? Send an offer on the cargo below.

board.title: Open cargo
board.empty: No cargo on this route right now. Clear the filter or post your own cargo.

detail.offerLead: If you are a carrier or a driver, write your price. The cargo owner compares offers and picks one.
detail.closedNote: A carrier was already chosen for this cargo, or the post is closed.

new.title: Post cargo
new.lead: Route, cargo, weight and date. Carriers send a price; your phone opens only to subscribed carriers.

err.RATE_LIMITED: Too many submissions. Try again in an hour.

form.title: Short title
form.titlePhCargo: e.g. 20 t of cement, Tashkent to Samarkand
form.descriptionPhCargo: How the cargo is packed, who loads and unloads, other terms
form.descriptionPhService: What needs doing, by when, which documents you have
form.phoneHint: The number opens only to subscribed providers. Leave it empty and they will write their offers here.
form.loginNeeded: You need to sign in to post. It takes a minute.
form.doneBody: Providers have been notified. Offers will show in your dashboard, and in Telegram if it is linked.

offer.priceHint: Leave empty for a negotiable price
offer.messagePh: When you can arrive, which truck, terms
offer.sentBody: You will be notified if the requester picks you. Your offers are in the dashboard.
offer.loginNeeded: You need to sign in to send an offer.
offer.OFFER_EXISTS: You already sent an offer on this request.
offer.NOT_PROVIDER: To answer service requests, first open a service profile of this type.

statusPage.noPrice: This page shows no prices or phone numbers. Feel free to share the link with partners.

dash.title: Cargo and services
dash.lead: Your posts, the offers they received, the offers you sent and your service profile.
dash.emptyRequests: No posts yet. A cargo post or a service request takes a minute.
dash.emptyOffers: You have not sent any offers yet. Open cargo and requests are on the board.
dash.noOffers: No offers yet. Providers have been notified.
dash.awardedNote: Provider chosen. Close the request once the work is done.
dash.confirmClose: The request will close and no new offers will arrive. Continue?
dash.confirmCancel: The request will be cancelled. Continue?
dash.statusLinkHint: Share with partners: prices and phones are hidden.

profile.lead: If you provide a service, list yourself: clients find you in the services centre, and requests of this type reach you as notifications.
profile.blocked: Hidden by the site admin: write to the help chat if you have a question
profile.title: Title
profile.descriptionPh: Which routes, which cargo, which documents. Clients read this and call.
profile.regionsHint: Pick none and it shows as all of Uzbekistan.
profile.priceNotePh: e.g. 150 000 UZS per document, or negotiable
profile.phoneHint: The number opens to subscribed clients.
profile.PROFILE_EXISTS: You already have a profile of this type. Edit it instead.
